plan.rationale: Revision is pinned to the only listed candidate aadf810b96b666d16a290554d5b014517a88fe816898331e7a4a0f7ae8b03cbf (bundle trial-d2a4cb48d3-param-21cc696e, quality pass, accepted). The observed uncertainty is candidate-scoped: the clean paired win is only ~46 us (4.227431 -> 4.181138 ms) although the parent trace attributes 0.428 ms to the 20 cudnn::bn_fw_inf kernels the fold removes. The candidate's own torch profile explains little of the gap: conv kernels are byte-for-byte comparable, batch_norm kernels are gone, but 20 new per-site output-sized elementwise add_ kernels (0.357 ms total, including a 207 us add on the [32,64,112,112] stem output) and 20 host-side aten::reshape calls now appear inside the folded sites, and peak_allocated_bytes rose 281.98 -> 326.96 MB, consistent with the retained folded weight/bias copies (~11.2M params x 4 B). Open questions before any next candidate: (1) are these per-site add_/reshape ops real steady-state costs of this exact candidate rather than discovery-instrumentation artifacts; (2) which CPU path submits each new add kernel (convolution bias handling vs activation module vs binding shim); (3) how much of the current 4.181 ms is GPU-busy versus idle gaps on the candidate (parent showed ~81 us gaps). candidate_diagnostics is selected to run route, per-site and kernel-composition diagnostics on this candidate in a separate worker; execution_timeline is selected for its independent plain Torch trace with CPU-to-CUDA submit associations, synchronization points and per-device busy/idle intervals to answer (2) and (3), accepting that only CPU-submission clock-alignment bounds are reported. Single-device evidence (communication not_applicable; zero NCCL kernels in both traces) makes nccl_tuning and collective_calibration inapplicable; device_telemetry cannot attribute device-wide NVML windows to a ~4.18 ms GPU-resident invocation; nsys is not selected because attribution is already complete (88/88, no ambiguous sequences) with no overlap or graph-tracing question; binding_cost is inapplicable because the bundle replaces the parent at all 20 sites (0 fallbacks, 0 reference invocations) rather than adding a passthrough; python_runtime is not re-requested because the parent run already showed host dispatch hidden behind GPU work and its perturbed cProfile times are not clean scores or GPU durations; the torch collector already ran on this candidate.
